note: Data-driven civic pathways. New domains are new rows, not new product code. Legalo v1 only loads the rows below.

scholarship.union_hint: National Scholarship Portal / central ministry schemes file as Central public authorities on rtionline.gov.in. State scholarships do not.

ration.union_hint: PDS / ration cards are State Food & Civil Supplies matters. Do not use rtionline.gov.in.

pension.union_hint: NSAP is Central; many old-age pensions are State. Ask scheme_level.

pf.union_hint: EPFO is a Central public authority. rtionline.gov.in may be used after confirming the office.

pending_application.why_en: The file is silent. An RTI asks where it is, who holds it, and why it is delayed. A grievance asks the office to act without that map. Start with the information request; a grievance can follow once you know the officer.
pending_application.why_hi: फ़ाइल चुप है। आरटीआई पूछता है कि फ़ाइल कहाँ है, किसके पास है, और देरी क्यों है। शिकायत बिना उस नक्शे के कार्रवाई माँगती है। पहले सूचना माँगें।
pending_application.not_en: This is not an eligibility opinion and not a consumer complaint against a private seller.

disbursement_failed.why_en: Approval without payment is a records problem: payment file, PFMS/DBT status, rejection memo. RTI for those records; then a grievance to the paying authority. Do not draft a consumer-forum complaint against the State unless a service-deficiency case is later made out.
disbursement_failed.why_hi: मंज़ूरी के बाद भुगतान न होना अभिलेख की समस्या है — भुगतान फ़ाइल, DBT स्थिति, अस्वीकृति आदेश। पहले आरटीआई।
disbursement_failed.not_en: Not a shop-refund matter. Not an eligibility guess.

verification_gap.why_en: If the office says documents/KYC are pending, ask in writing which document, which date, and which officer. RTI for the deficiency memo; then supply the document or dispute it.
verification_gap.why_hi: यदि कार्यालय कहता है दस्तावेज़/KYC बाकी हैं, तो लिखित में पूछें कौन-सा दस्तावेज़, किस तारीख, किस अधिकारी ने।
verification_gap.not_en: Do not guess which document is missing.

eligibility_question.why_en: Legalo does not have a live scheme-eligibility corpus. Inventing whether you qualify would be unsourced. You may RTI the department for the eligibility criteria, circulars and your application's evaluation note that it already holds.
eligibility_question.why_hi: लीगैलो के पास योजना पात्रता की लाइव सूची नहीं है। पात्रता गढ़ना अस्रोत होगा। विभाग से मापदंड और आपकी फ़ाइल की मूल्यांकन टिप्पणी आरटीआई से माँगी जा सकती है।
eligibility_question.not_en: No yes/no eligibility answer without an official circular in the dated corpus.

explicit_information_request.why_en: The citizen already asked for status or copies. Route as RTI under section 6. Do not convert it into a grievance unless they also want action.
explicit_information_request.why_hi: नागरिक पहले से स्थिति या प्रतियाँ माँग रहा है। धारा 6 के आरटीआई के रूप में मार्ग।

defect_refund_refused.why_en: A private seller refused a remedy for defective goods. That is a consumer dispute under CPA 2019, not an RTI to a ministry.
defect_refund_refused.why_hi: निजी विक्रेता ने दोषपूर्ण सामान पर उपाय से इनकार किया। यह CPA 2019 का उपभोक्ता विवाद है, मंत्रालय को आरटीआई नहीं।
defect_refund_refused.not_en: Do not draft an RTI to Consumer Affairs for a shop refund.

essential_supply_cut.why_en: Withholding electricity/water is treated as an essential-supply issue in the Model Tenancy Act 2021 s.20 — only where a State has enacted it. Not an RTI unless the DISCOM is the actor and is a public authority.
essential_supply_cut.why_hi: बिजली/पानी काटना मॉडल किरायेदारी अधिनियम 2021 धारा 20 में आवश्यक आपूर्ति है — जहाँ राज्य ने अपनाया हो।
essential_supply_cut.not_en: Not a consumer-phone complaint. Not automatically an RTI.

informal_eviction.why_en: A two-day vacate letter is not an eviction order under the Model Tenancy Act 2021 s.21 (where enacted). Route to a written representation and the competent Rent Court / State Act — not to a consumer commission.
informal_eviction.why_hi: दो दिन का खाली करने का पत्र बेदखली का आदेश नहीं है (मॉडल धारा 21, जहाँ लागू)।
informal_eviction.not_en: Not a welfare RTI unless records of a public housing authority are needed.

police_assault.why_en: This is alleged use of force by a police officer — a human-rights complaint, not a records request and not a shop dispute. The dated corpus has NHRC/HRCNet filing rules, not Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita or IPC offence sections, so Legalo will not invent those section numbers. Route to a self-contained complaint on HRCNet (NHRC or the State Commission).
police_assault.why_hi: यह पुलिस अधिकारी द्वारा बल प्रयोग का आरोप है — मानवाधिकार शिकायत, आरटीआई या दुकान विवाद नहीं। कॉर्पस में NHRC/HRCNet की प्रक्रिया है, BNS/IPC की धाराएँ नहीं; वे गढ़ेंगे नहीं।
police_assault.not_en: Not an RTI. Not a consumer complaint. Not a tenancy draft. Not an unsourced FIR template with invented BNS/IPC sections.

unpaid_wages.why_en: This is an employment dispute with a private employer, not a shop-refund and not a welfare RTI (unless the record is PF/EPFO). State labour statutes differ. The dated corpus has the Ministry of Labour portal, not a full Industrial Disputes Act pack, so Legalo will not invent IDA/Shops Act section numbers. Route: a written demand, then the State labour machinery listed on labour.gov.in.
unpaid_wages.why_hi: यह निजी नियोक्ता से रोजगार विवाद है, दुकान-वापसी या कल्याण आरटीआई नहीं (जब तक अभिलेख PF/EPFO न हो)। राज्य श्रम कानून भिन्न। IDA धाराएँ गढ़ेंगे नहीं।
unpaid_wages.not_en: Not a consumer complaint. Not an RTI to a ministry about a private wage. Not a tenancy draft.
